research_rationale:
Complete official original and full EO9830 PartsI–III were read and operative primary pages inspected. EO9830 opening makes the entire order effective May1,1947; PartIII expressly names the target and PartII restates the Civil Service Rules. The selected end is the named-target endpoint under the owner October21 unnamed-instruments ruling, not a finding that all substantive host-rule application stayed unchanged earlier. No own sunset, completed single assignment or independent original command survives outside the corrected inventory. Earlier unnamed host changes and savings are separately pinned in source_notes; no exact effective date is invented for qualified administrative candidates. The native original evidence is the actual FR representation; uncited derivative working-text leads receive no confirmation.
